sub_indicators.label: Digital skills of the public
sub_indicators.subject: capacity.literacy
sub_indicators.text: Digital literacy (general population): digital skills of the public
sub_indicators.norm_short: The Digital Transformation Strategy asks for 300 million Africans a year trained in e-skills; Agenda 2063's second ten-year plan asks for 80 per cent of primary completers digitally proficient by 2033.
criteria: A source from the past three years says no programme teaches the public digital skills.
The government, alone or with partners, has launched, piloted or is preparing a programme to teach digital skills to the public.
A national digital-skills programme for the public is in service and has trained a stated number of people.
A measured share of adults or of the population with basic digital skills is published, from a survey.
A measured share of half or more of adults with basic digital skills is published.
